bottleneck.description: Defense and space-station component supplier (signals intelligence, GNC, life-support) leading Starlab commercial LEO station consortium - one of three competing NASA CLD bidders alongside Axiom and Orbital Reef.

dependency.key_customers: NASA, US Air Force, Lockheed Martin, Palantir, Sierra Space, Northrop Grumman, intelligence community
dependency.key_suppliers: Airbus, MDA Space, Mitsubishi (Starlab partners); diversified electronics and aerospace component vendors

editorial.notes: Voyager (NYSE-listed June 2025) is a diversified defense electronics and space-infrastructure integrator without a clearly dominant chokepoint product. Its Starlab project is in active competition with Axiom and the Blue Origin/Sierra Space-led Orbital Reef for NASA's Commercial LEO Destinations program - no exclusive franchise. Defense & National Security segment offers communications, GNC, and SIGINT modules where multiple primes compete. LOW reflects competitive landscape across both segments.
